description: ResInsight is a reservoir visualisation and post-processing application for simulation results, faults, wells and multiple realisations. It supports Eclipse formats and two-way interaction with Python and GNU Octave. The provider is Ceetron and Equinor. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository states GPL version 3 or later. Third-party libraries retain their own licences. Limitations: It is a viewer and analysis tool, so reservoir predictions depend on separately obtained simulator results. Supported-platform and performance claims were not tested. For simulation it helps inspect ensemble behaviour and prepare or interpret reservoir studies. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this reservoir post-processing tool.
